name: nq_mini
description: Offline Natural-Questions-style QA fixture with short answers for RAG generation eval.

documents.text: The capital of France is Paris. Paris is located on the Seine river and hosts the Louvre museum.
GF(3) is the finite field with three elements {0,1,2} under modulo-3 arithmetic, used in non-binary LDPC codes.
MS MARCO is a large-scale passage ranking and QA dataset built from Bing search queries and web passages.
NOR flash CiM stores multi-level cell conductance for in-array MAC; drift and read disturb are major reliability issues.
nDCG@10 is a standard information retrieval metric evaluating the top-10 ranked documents with graded relevance.
A residual GEMV calibrator adds a gated delta-LLR correction on top of the multi-cycle B-prime soft LLR product.
Edge RAG keeps the document corpus on-device so private semiconductor process documents are never uploaded.
Belief propagation decoding iteratively exchanges messages on the Tanner graph of a parity-check matrix H.
The SIGIR conference is the premier venue for research in information retrieval, ranking, and search systems.
Hallucination in RAG occurs when a language model generates facts not supported by the retrieved passages.

queries.query: What is the capital of France?
What is GF(3) in coding theory?
